channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: O que acontece se Messias for rejeitado pelo Senado?
item.description: If the Senate rejects Jorge Messias's nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, President Lula must submit a new candidate for the vacancy, which will require renewed Senate approval. This situation has not occurred since 1894, marking an unprecedented event in over a century.

item.title: O périplo de Gilmar na mídia e suas desculpas a Zema por fala homofóbica
item.description: Minister Gilmar Mendes gave seven interviews in three days, revealing his views on the STF and the Constitution. During this media tour, he made a homophobic remark for which he later apologized to Minas Gerais Governor Romeu Zema. The episode highlighted tensions between the judiciary and public opinion on sensitive issues such as LGBTQ+ rights.

item.title: Aliados dizem ter votos, mas agem até o último minuto por Messias no STF
item.description: Allies of Attorney General Jorge Messias claim to have the necessary votes for his Supreme Court nomination, but are working until the last minute to secure support ahead of today’s Senate hearing. Uncertainty over the final tally reflects the tense political maneuvering around President Lula’s nominee. The Senate’s Constitution and Justice Committee will decide the fate of the appointment today.

item.title: Grupos de WhatsApp revelam direita em reconfiguração e esquerda unida
item.description: Lula leads the 2026 presidential race in the first round across all surveyed scenarios, while technically tying with Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round, with the difference within the margin of error. WhatsApp groups reveal a reconfiguring right and a more united left around the former president.

item.title: Alcolumbre, presidente do Senado, pode muito, mas não pode tudo
item.description: Senate President David Alcolumbre may influence the vote on Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, but does not have full control, especially in the plenary where a simple majority of 41 senators is required. The CCJ hearing will be decisive, but secret voting and parliamentary negotiations make the outcome uncertain, despite government confidence in the commission's majority.

item.title: Messias vai debater papel STF e cobrar retidão de juízes, mas terá placar apertado no Senado
item.description: Jorge Messias, Lula's nominee to the STF, faces a Senate hearing with expectations of a tight vote due to government weariness and opposition from Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. Allies estimate between 44 and 52 favorable votes in the plenary, while the CCJ initially showed a narrow 9-8 split in favor, now trending upward. The hearing is expected to focus more on the role of the STF than on Messias' professional background.

item.title: Lula deverá se manifestar a favor de investigação contra Flávio
item.description: President Lula is expected to publicly support the continuation of investigations against Flávio Bolsonaro for alleged slander in a social media post, according to government allies. The Federal Police consulted Lula on whether he wishes to file a formal complaint, as offenses against honor require the victim’s initiative to proceed. The inquiry, opened by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, stems from a January post in which Bolsonaro claimed 'Lula will be denounced' and accused the São Paulo Forum of drug trafficking, money laundering, election fraud, and support for dictatorships and terrorists.

item.title: Alcolumbre avalia receber Messias no Senado após sabatina
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre is considering receiving Justice Minister Jorge Messias after Messias’ CCJ hearing, according to Alcolumbre’s interlocutors and Senator Weverton Rocha. The meeting would be institutional and take place between the CCJ hearing and the plenary vote on Messias’ STF nomination. Alcolumbre was upset about the leak of a prior private meeting with Messias at Justice Cristiano Zanin’s residence, believing the government leaked it to falsely imply his support.

item.title: De Lava-Jato a ADPF das Favelas: Messias poderá assumir acervo de mais de 600 processos deixados por Barroso
item.description: Jorge Messias, nominated by Lula to replace Luís Roberto Barroso at the STF, will inherit 683 cases, including Lava-Jato and ADPF das Favelas matters. The confirmation hearing may signal the future dynamics between the government and Congress, as the new justice cannot vote on cases where Barroso has already expressed his position.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro faz campanha contra Messias usando aborto e 8 de Janeiro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is using the Attorney General's Office (AGU) offensive demanding compensation from January 8 rioters and an AGU opinion on abortion as ammunition to oppose Jorge Messias's nomination to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), aiming to block his appointment.

item.title: Michelle sela a paz com Flávio Bolsonaro e fará gesto público de apoio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro reconciled with her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), after months of behind-the-scenes negotiations by his allies. She committed to making a public gesture of support for his 2026 presidential candidacy, including statements on her social media. The reconciliation follows a period of estrangement between the two.

item.title: PSB, de Pacheco, divulga nota de apoio a Messias no STF
item.description: The PSB announced its support for Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, emphasizing his experience as Attorney General of the Union and National Treasury Prosecutor. The party's note highlights Messias' commitment to the Constitution and democratic institutions, following political tensions arising from Lula's decision not to nominate former Senate President Rodrigo Pacheco for the vacancy.

item.title: Oposição cogita 'desmembrar' veto de Lula ao PL da Dosimetria para não afetar Lei Antifacção
item.description: Opposition and Centrão lawmakers are considering splitting Lula’s veto on the Dosimetry Bill to preserve a provision that maintains the Anti-Coup Law, preventing the full overturn of the veto from benefiting those convicted of the January 8 attacks. The government insists the veto must be voted on as a whole, warning that splitting it would weaken the Anti-Coup Law, while the opposition sees splitting as a way to counter the government’s political use of the issue.

item.title: Maranhão: aliados de Dino apoiarão PSD em disputa contra sobrinho do governador se candidato pedir voto a Lula
item.description: Allies of Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino, including PT members, are seeking Lula’s endorsement to support Eduardo Braide (PSD) for governor of Maranhão, conditioning their backing on Braide explicitly asking for Lula’s vote. On the other side, Governor Carlos Brandão (unaffiliated) is promoting his nephew, Orleans Brandão (MDB), as his successor, leveraging his close ties to Lula. The split between Dino’s and Brandão’s factions was sealed in 2024, notably when Brandão was not invited to Dino’s wedding, and has since deepened due to political and personal differences.

item.title: De 'Bessias' a ponte do governo com evangélicos: veja trajetória de Messias, indicado por Lula ao STF
item.description: Jorge Messias, the Advocate-General of the Union and Lula's nominee for the Supreme Federal Court, is 46 years old and has a career shaped by close ties to PT figures such as Aloizio Mercadante and Jaques Wagner, along with service at the AGU since 2007. He gained national notoriety as 'Bessias' after a 2016 wiretap in which Dilma Rousseff referenced him in a call with Lula, a moment tied to the Lava-Jato investigation. Despite the embarrassing nickname, he maintains political connections beyond the left, including an approach to Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI).

item.title: Após salto nas redes, Zema adia corpo a corpo para ganhar conhecimento antes de disputar votos
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) is postponing in-person voter engagements to focus on building national recognition through social media and high-reach events like Agrishow, following a visibility surge from a controversy with Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes. Despite gaining over 100,000 followers in under 24 hours, allies say the impact has not yet appeared in polls and that consolidating his name must come before grassroots campaigning. The strategy aims to turn recent exposure into a competitive positioning on the right, waiting for the right moment to travel across states to convert votes.

item.title: Suspensão de multas, Desenrola, combustíveis: governo turbina benesses em ano eleitoral de olho na classe média
item.description: The Lula government announced the suspension of 3.4 million traffic fines on free-flow toll highways, part of a broader strategy to boost popularity among the middle class in an election year. The move joins other initiatives such as the Desenrola debt-relief program and fuel subsidies, aimed at improving presidential approval ahead of a potential rematch with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Da inauguração na ditadura até os embates nos governos Lula e Bolsonaro: entenda o conflito em torno das obras na BR-319
item.description: The president of the TRF1 lifted the injunction blocking electronic bids for the paving of BR-319, allowing the Dnit to proceed with contracting for the asphaltation of 339.4 km in the road’s most preserved stretch. The Lula administration is using a provision in the new environmental licensing law — previously vetoed by Lula himself — to bypass Ibama and speed up the project, despite warnings of significant environmental impact in the Amazon. The over two-decade conflict between regional development and environmental preservation has reignited, with the project’s estimated budget rising from R$ 678 million to over R$ 1,3 billion.

item.title: Senado aprovou todos os nomes de indicados ao STF desde 1988
item.description: Since 1988, the Brazilian Senate has never rejected a Supreme Court nomination, approving all 29 nominees put forward by presidents, including Flávio Dino and Cristiano Zanin in 2023. Jorge Messias, nominated by Lula to replace the retired Luís Roberto Barroso (who stepped down in October 2025), is undergoing a CCJ hearing this Wednesday (April 29, 2026) ahead of a floor vote. The process includes a CCJ hearing, secret committee vote, and final approval in the plenary requiring an absolute majority of at least 41 votes from 81 senators.

item.title: Políticos de MG apostam que Cleitinho pode desistir mesmo liderando
item.description: Cleitinho Azevedo leads the polls for governor of Minas Gerais, but politicians from both the right and left believe he may withdraw his candidacy. Despite leading in all scenarios, the high percentage of undecided voters (86% in spontaneous responses) and the willingness to change votes (60%) cast doubt on the solidity of his support. Governor Mateus Simões (PSD) remains calm, noting that candidates who start behind often go on to win.

item.title: Bolsonarista reservou Paulista em 2024 e frustra 1º de Maio sindical
item.description: The Bolsonarist rally on Avenida Paulista on May 1st was booked nearly two years in advance by Jair Bolsonaro supporters, forcing the Conlutas union to relocate its event to Praça da República. The Patriotas do QG page, linked to Flávio Bolsonaro and created by a real estate broker, expects 35,000 participants, though right-wing leaders have not confirmed attendance.

item.title: Sucessão no STF: relembre os indicados à Corte desde a redemocratização
item.description: Since redemocratization, eight presidents have nominated 11 justices to the Supreme Federal Tribunal, with Lula presenting his 11th nominee: Jorge Messias, current Attorney General of the Union. The nomination is under review in the Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee and requires plenary approval. The STF has 11 seats, filled by presidential nomination following senatorial approval.

item.title: PL aciona TSE para limitar pronunciamento de Lula no 1º de maio
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) has filed a request with the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) to restrict President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) national radio and television address on May 1st, claiming it constitutes personal promotion and direct association of his image with government policies, along with criticism of political opponents. The PL seeks a preventive injunction to ensure institutional neutrality, ban the use of external images and visual elements that could characterize premature electoral propaganda. The request is grounded in Lula's history of national addresses since 2023, including measures such as minimum wage increases and income tax exemptions for monthly earnings up to R$ 5,000.

item.title: Para Lula, é ‘vencer ou vencer’ com Messias
item.description: Lula faces a critical test in the Senate with the vote on Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF. A defeat would weaken his position before Congress and the electorate, marking a 'win or win' moment for his third term. The article highlights that the outcome could significantly impact his political authority.

item.title: Na sabatina de Messias, o que menos conta é o currículo de Messias
item.description: Jorge Messias, Lula's nominee to the Supreme Court, faces his confirmation hearing in the Senate today after a five-month wait. Although allies anticipate a tough process, they project a narrow approval with just a few votes above the 41 needed for confirmation. The coverage emphasizes the political tension of the hearing rather than Messias' qualifications.

item.title: Motta diz que queda do veto da dosimetria pode levar STF a rever penas
item.description: Hugo Motta, president of the Chamber of Deputies, states that the overthrow of the presidential veto on the Dosimetry Bill could lead the STF to reinterpret the sentences of those convicted for the January 8 acts, allowing prisoners to leave closed regime and serve sentences under other modalities. He calls the project a 'politically possible construction' to avoid institutional crisis and pacify the country after January 8, advocating that Congress must act responsibly in resolving the issue.

item.title: TSE deve definir na quinta como fica o governo de Roraima após cassação do governador
item.description: The TSE confirmed the removal of Governor Edilson Damião (União Brasil) and the eight-year ineligibility of former Governor Antonio Denarium (Republicanos) due to electoral crimes in the 2022 elections. The decision will be officially proclaimed on Thursday (30), after which new elections will be held in Roraima, with the state legislative assembly president assuming the governorship on an interim basis until the vote.

item.title: Senado analisa nesta quarta-feira indicação de Jorge Messias para vaga no STF; veja perfil
item.description: The Senate is reviewing on Wednesday (29) the nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), proposed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to fill the vacancy left by Luís Roberto Barroso. Messias, current Minister of the Attorney General's Office (AGU) and a Lula confidant since the Dilma Rousseff administration, will undergo a hearing in the Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) before a potential plenary vote. This marks Lula's third nomination to the STF.

item.title: Messias precisa de 41 votos no Senado para chegar ao STF; relembre outros placares
item.description: Jorge Messias, Brazil's Attorney General, needs 41 Senate votes to be confirmed to the Supreme Court following Lula's nomination for the vacancy left by Barroso. The vote will be secret and tight, with the government claiming 25 secured votes, 35 opposed, and 21 undecided. Recent nominations of Flávio Dino (47-31) and André Mendonça also passed by narrow margins, highlighting congressional polarization.

item.title: A uma semana do prazo para regularizar o título de eleitor, veja passo a passo para o processor
item.description: The deadline to regularize voter registration ends in one week, and those with irregular titles will be unable to vote in the October general elections or access public services such as public job applications, passports, or public school enrollment. The TSE offers free online consultation, and regularization can be completed via the Electoral Self-Service portal with tracking. The first round of elections is on October 4, with a potential runoff on October 25.

item.title: Sabatina, comissão e plenário: saiba o passo a passo no Senado para analisar indicação de Messias ao STF
item.description: Advocacy General Jorge Messias will undergo a Senate confirmation hearing in the Constitution and Justice Committee this Wednesday, followed by a floor vote, to be appointed as a new Supreme Court Justice replacing Luís Roberto Barroso. Approval requires a simple majority in both the committee and the full Senate via secret vote, after which his swearing-in can proceed.

item.title: Messias será sabatinado nesta quarta com disputa voto a voto entre governo e oposição
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias will face a confirmation hearing in the Senate’s Constitution and Justice Committee for a Supreme Court seat, with a secret ballot and a vote-by-vote contest between government and opposition. Approval in the committee requires a simple majority, but final confirmation in the plenary needs 41 senators, also by secret vote. Despite efforts by Senator Alcolumbre to block the nomination, Messias had an informal meeting with the Senate president and allies, described as a reunion of friends, though Alcolumbre has not publicly committed to supporting him.

item.title: Indicado por Lula ao STF, Messias chega hoje a sabatina no Senado com placar indefinido; veja enquete do GLOBO
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias faces an uncertain Senate hearing for his Supreme Court nomination, with 25 in favor, 22 against, and 34 undecided senators. Though government allies expect approval, the vote is seen as a gauge of Lula’s relationship with Congress, amid tensions with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and concerns over last-minute shifts.

item.title: Liderança de Lula no 1º turno e empate técnico com Flávio no 2º: o que diz nova AtlasIntel
item.description: Lula leads in the first round of the 2026 elections, while Flávio Bolsonaro is technically tied with him in a potential runoff, according to AtlasIntel. U.S. President Donald Trump announced that Iran contacted his government claiming to be in a 'state of collapse' and urged the U.S. Navy to lift its naval blockade on Iranian ships and ports in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Oposição diz ter votos para derrubar veto de Lula à Dosimetria
item.description: The opposition estimates it has enough votes to overturn Lula's veto on the Dosimetria bill, which reduces penalties for those involved in the January 8 acts and could benefit Bolsonaro. In the Chamber, 330 votes are projected (above the 257 needed), and in the Senate, 58 (above the 41 needed). Although the government claims it will uphold the veto, arguing it aligns with the Anti-Faction Law, behind the scenes defeat is already anticipated.

item.title: TSE deve concluir na quinta (30) julgamento do governador de Roraima
item.description: The TSE is set to conclude on Thursday (30) the trial that could remove Roraima's governor, Edilson Damião, after a 6x1 majority voted for his disqualification and the call for new elections. Minister André Mendonça is expected to present the remainder of his vote to finalize the outcome. Former governor Antonio Denarium has already been unanimously declared ineligible for eight years due to political and economic abuse in the 2022 elections.

item.title: Messias chega a sabatina para STF sob risco de derrota histórica e com incerteza sobre Alcolumbre
item.description: President Lula's nominee for the STF, Jorge Messias, faces uncertainty in the Senate hearing due to lack of explicit support from Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, putting his approval at risk and potentially leading to a historic defeat for the government.

item.title: Fachin teve sabatina para ministro do STF mais longa, e Cármen, a mais curta; veja histórico
item.description: Justice Edson Fachin had the longest confirmation hearing in STF history before the CCJ, while Justice Cármen Lúcia had the shortest. The article explains the Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) vetting process for Supreme Court nominees, highlighting variations in hearing length based on candidate and political context.

item.title: Governistas avaliam que Alcolumbre também perderia com rejeição de Messias e pedem bom senso
item.description: Allied senators of the Lula government say that rejecting Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF would harm not only the government and Messias himself, but also Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. They urge rationality in the vote, warning that defeat would carry broader political consequences.

item.title: PT tenta atrair Dorinha e Confúcio para fortalecer Lula no Norte
item.description: The PT is forming alliances in Brazil's North to bolster Lula's re-election bid, seeking support from Senator Professora Dorinha (União Brasil) in Tocantins and Senator Confúcio Moura (MDB) in Rondônia. PT Secretary-General Henrique Fontana states these talks prioritize a clear commitment to Lula's re-election, even with parties across the political spectrum. Despite these efforts, polls show declining support for Lula in the North ahead of the 2026 election.

item.title: Presidentes do TSE e dos TREs projetam metas para as Eleições 2026
item.description: Minister Cármen Lúcia, president of the TSE, presented a management balance with record biometric registration levels and outlined the strategic planning for the 2026 Elections in a meeting with the presidents of the 22 TREs. The meeting reinforced goals of security and technological expansion to ensure vote integrity and democratic transparency, focusing on coordination with security forces and the Federal Police to combat electoral crimes. Nunes Marques will assume the TSE Presidency in May.

item.title: TSE tem maioria para cassar governador de Roraima e tornar ex-governador inelegível
item.description: The TSE formed a majority to remove Roraima Governor Edilson Damião and declare former Governor Antonio Denarium ineligible for eight years due to abuse of power in distributing basic food baskets and housing benefits during the 2022 campaign. The ruling was suspended and will resume on Thursday, the 30th. Denarium had previously resigned to run for the Senate, allowing Damião to assume the governorship.

item.title: TSE cassa governador de RR e deixa inelegível Antonio Denarium, pré-candidato ao Senado
item.description: The TSE annulled the mandate of Roraima's governor, Edilson Damião, and declared former governor Antonio Denarium ineligible for 8 years, until 2030, for abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 elections, involving improper use of public machinery and social programs. The decision was unanimous regarding Denarium's ineligibility, while Damião lost his mandate for benefiting from the irregularities without direct participation. New elections will be called to define a temporary mandate until the end of the year.

item.title: TSE cassa mandato de governador de Roraima e torna Antônio Denarium inelegível
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) annulled the mandate of former Roraima governor Antônio Denarium and declared him ineligible for eight years due to abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 elections, with a unanimous vote. Current interim governor Edilson Damião had his mandate revoked by a 6-1 majority for the same reasons, including the improper use of social programs like 'Cesta da Família' and 'Morar Melhor' to gain electoral advantage. The trial was suspended after Minister André Mendonça requested to present a vote complement, with the next session scheduled for April 30.

item.title: Caiado critica gestões do PT e diz que se Bolsonaro tivesse governado bem não teria perdido eleição
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized the PT and Jair Bolsonaro's administrations, stating that if Bolsonaro had governed well, he would not have lost the 2022 election. He cited his 88% approval rating in Goiás and argued that Brazil's solution lies in good governance, moving beyond polarization and focusing on results, especially in agribusiness. Caiado also accused the Lula government of increasing bureaucracy and tax burden, hindering the country's potential for three annual harvests.

item.title: Com maioria para cassação, julgamento de ex-governador de RR é adiado
item.description: The TSE postponed the judgment that could cassate the ticket of Antonio Denarium and Edilson Damião, elected in 2022 for the government of Roraima, after reaching a majority of 6 to 1 in favor of cassation. The postponement was made to allow Minister André Mendonça to adjust his vote before the session resumes on Thursday (April 30, 2026). The Court rejected the idea of separating the effects of the conviction, maintaining that the ticket is indivisible in majoritarian elections.

item.title: Gestão Tarcísio propõe salário-mínimo estadual de R$ 1.874, com reajuste de 3,9%
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas proposed raising São Paulo's state minimum wage to R$1,874, a 3.9% increase. The bill was submitted to the state legislature and awaits approval by deputies before taking effect.

item.title: Demitido do governo de MG por ser alvo de investigação colabora em programa de Zema
item.description: Rossieli Soares was dismissed from the Minas Gerais Secretariat of Education after becoming a target of an investigation by the State General Controller. Despite his dismissal, he continues to contribute to the government program of presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema (Novo). The decision highlights tensions between state governance and the governor’s national ambitions.

item.title: Visita ao Poder360: Leandro Grass
item.description: Leandro Grass, the PT's pre-candidate for governor of the Federal District, visited the Poder360 headquarters in Brasília to give a recorded interview, discussing what he believes needs improvement in the city and sharing his views on the October election. He was accompanied by press advisor Adriana Caitano Ribeiro.

item.title: TSE cassa mandato de governador de Roraima e torna Denarium inelegível por 8 anos
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has upheld the removal of Roraima's governor, Edilson Damião, and declared former governor Antonio Denarium ineligible for 8 years due to abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 elections. Although the ruling is not yet formally proclaimed, it confirms the TRE-RR's January 2024 decision, triggering the need for new elections in the state, with the legislative assembly president serving as interim governor until the vote. Damião, who took office after Denarium resigned to run for Senate, will lose his mandate after just one month in office.
